task.title: Replace feedback/documentation with decision build orchestration
task.summary: Introduce the vNext decision_build path as a clean replacement for routine feedback/documentation compiler code, with direct decision-to-planning handoff and no backwards-compatibility wrappers in package source.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki uses decision_build as the clean semantic intent-to-knowledge handoff and planning consumes decision_build directly.
acceptance: Decision build kind/schema is represented in domain/application/adapters as the semantic build path.
Decision orchestration supports proposal and accepted modes with no canonical writes before approval.
Accepted decision artifacts record approved rows, row-to-KB mappings, product/system propagation direction, assumptions, risks, and downstream planning questions.
Planning builds consume source_decision_build directly; routine source_documentation_build requirements are removed from package source.
Feedback/documentation compiler loops are removed from primary package source/tests rather than kept as compatibility wrappers.
non_goals: Do not implement graph diagram-ref audits or gate fast paths in this task.
Do not consolidate all public workflow tools in this task.
Do not implement TASK-002 diagram migration beyond decision_build refs needed by this task.
verification: Run typecheck and focused build/tool smoke tests.
Validate decision-build traceability with a new or updated smoke test.
Run CodeWiki alignment and stale-reference audits.
